en: A black-and-white image depicting a large, traditional European building with a steep, tiled roof and a clock on its facade. The building is likely a town hall, as it has an official appearance with multiple windows, a balcony, and a flagpole in front. There are trees and a small park area visible to the right, and the immediate area is clear of people. The lower right corner of the image contains printed German text.
